title: Find the Duplicate Number
summary: An array of n + 1 numbers from 1 to n has exactly one repeated value. Find it without modifying the array and with O(1) extra space.

tests.explain: 4 appears twice; every other value appears once.
The duplicate may repeat more than twice. Here 1 and 3 are missing and 2 fills their places.

hints: A Set finds the repeat in O(n) space, and sorting changes the array. Both break the rules. Think of each index as a node instead.
Draw an arrow from every index i to index nums[i]. Starting at index 0, you follow a path that must eventually loop. Where does the loop begin?
Two different indices point to the duplicate value, so the loop's entry is the duplicate. Find it with Floyd's algorithm: meet with slow and fast, then restart one pointer at 0 and step both by one.

complexity.time: O(n): two Floyd walks over at most n + 1 indices
complexity.space: O(1): two indices, and the array is never written
